text:
priya: FYI - after the keystore rotate last night, I noticed a ~3h gap in audit events for decrypt calls from the deploy pipeline. no 'kms:Decrypt' entries between 02:10-05:12 UTC.
alex: ack. which pipeline / service account?
priya: `ci-deploy-prod` service account. some PRs failed artifacts verify, rolled back. saw errors: 
```
Error: unable to decrypt artifact: access denied
cause: access denied for key arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456:key/abcd-ef01
```
sam: very likely a role-binding drift to the KMS grant after rotation. sometimes our automation recreates key aliases and forgets to copy grants.
marie: can we query CloudTrail/CloudWatch for key usage? runbook suggests `aws cloudtrail lookup-events --lookup-attributes AttributeKey=EventName,AttributeValue=Decrypt` but that's noisy.
priya: I ran a focused query: `--start-time 2024-04-18T02:00:00Z --end-time 2024-04-18T06:00:00Z --resource TheKeyId` - returns zero decrypt events.
sec-oncall: tagging for oncall review @sec-oncall :eyes: - this could be an incident if customers impacted. what's blast radius?
priya: limited to internal artifact verification and one small customer canary. no PII exposed.
alex: OK triage plan: 1) confirm KMS grants for `ci-deploy-prod` 2) reapply missing grants if needed 3) backfill audit evidence 4) create postmortem and long-term fix to automation.
sam: to reapply: `aws kms create-grant --key-id <key-id> --grantee-principal arn:aws:iam::123456:role/ci-deploy-role --operations Decrypt --name deploy-grant` - but be cautious: creating duplicate grants can complicate rotation audits.
marie: for audit backfill: we should export proxy logs and pipeline logs and attach them to the incident. also add a synthetic decrypt call so future rotations are validated.
priya: I tried a synthetic decrypt with the SA after reapplying a grant; result: success. decrypt entries now show up in CloudTrail.
devops-bot: deployment-check: canary status: FAIL -> reverting to previous artifact (automated).
sec-oncall: good to hear it's reverted. please file an incident with timeline + CLI commands used. set Sev3 for now.
priya: filing now. quick q: SAST output also spiking in same timeframe — unrelated? I saw a flood of new fingerprint matches for proto-generated code; might be a scanner rule change pushed around 03:00 UTC.
alex: likely coincidental but treat as separate thread. if SAST had a new ruleset deployed, we should track who merged the ruleset and if suppressions were auto-applied.
marie: I've seen the SAST noise before — proto-generated files should be whitelisted via checksum, not folder-based suppression. I'll open a small change to adjust fingerprinting.
sam: action items: (a) priya attach incident doc link when filed (b) marie update SAST fingerprint whitelist (c) alex add a unit in onboarding automation: validate grants & audit events post-rotation (d) sec-oncall to confirm Sev and customer comms.
priya: Incident created: https://redwood.incidents/INC-20240418-006 - added timeline + CloudTrail query + created grant command used.
sec-oncall: thanks. also add a note to the rotation runbook: step to run `aws kms list-grants --key-id <key> --grantee-principal <principal>` and `aws cloudtrail lookup-events` to validate decrypts.
alex: agree. I'll take the runbook edit.
marie: I'll follow up with a tiny eval to reduce proto FP rate and share before/after with SRE.
priya: closing loop: verified logs, successful synthetic decrypt, pipeline back to green. leaving open until runbook + SAST change merged. :thumbsup:
